resources.string: UltimateLauncher is NOT the default launcher yet.
Allow UltimateLauncher to run in the background so widgets keep updating. If your phone has no dedicated screen, the app details page opens instead.
The file lists the apps installed on this phone, which is sensitive information. You can encrypt it with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM). No network is used: pick any place in the system document picker.
Imported. A copy of the previous layout was saved as %1$s.
This file uses schema %1$d, newer than this app supports.
Wrong passphrase, or the file was altered.
Removes all apps from the dock recents.
Shows the last apps opened from this launcher (up to 4). Stored only on this device; turning it off deletes them.
Shows translucent pills behind the dock icons. Off: icons only.
Apps grow from the tapped icon. Off: AOSP reveal animation.
The icon you launched pops back when you return to the launcher. The app window itself is closed by the system.
Without this, the system (ColorOS, EMUI, MagicOS...) may kill the launcher in the background and the home screen reloads (blank icons for a moment) when you come back.
Don\'t optimize battery for the launcher
Battery optimization is OFF for UltimateLauncher (good).
Battery optimization is ON: the system may kill the launcher.
Animates the return to the icon after the swipe-up gesture. Off by default: on ColorOS it can leave the icons hidden for a moment.
No card: title on top, icons over the blurred wallpaper and the rest of the home screen hidden.
Follows the system orientation so the grid, dock and folders also work in landscape. Off by default (portrait home like OPPO).
No room to expand this folder
Long-press a folder on the home screen to expand it to 2x2: its apps show on the tile and open with one tap.
Large time on a rounded card, with the day and date. Tap to open the clock app.
Lets the home grid use the full width on tablets, with no side margins. Off keeps the measured Huawei margins.

Brings icons, folders, dock and pages from another launcher. Nothing leaves your phone (no network). Apps that are not installed here are skipped; widgets come back empty and need one tap to accept the system prompt. The icon pack is not imported: pick it again in your icon pack app.
No other launcher found. You can still pick a backup file below.
It protects its layout with the permission %1$s, which this app does not hold (system permission). Use its backup file instead.
It does not expose its layout to other apps.
(route not verified on a real device yet)
%1$s is a closed launcher: it does not expose anything to normal apps, so its layout cannot be imported automatically. Use \"Place my apps in order\" or see the alternatives below.
Pick a Launcher3 database (.db) or a backup zip such as .lawnchairbackup or .novabackup with the system document picker. No storage permission is needed.
This file is an UltimateLauncher export: use «Export / import layout».
If your launcher is closed (OPPO, Xiaomi, Huawei, vivo, Samsung…)

There is no legitimate way to read their layout without system privileges, so this app does not try. Options: (1) check whether the old launcher can export a backup file and pick it above; (2) take a screenshot of each home page, then place your apps here following the screenshots (long-press an icon in the drawer to drop it on the page); (3) keep the old phone until you have placed everything.
%1$d apps, %2$d folders (%3$d apps inside), %4$d widgets and %5$d dock items will be imported in %6$d page(s). %7$d omitted.
Your current home screen will be replaced. A copy of it is saved first.
The file was larger than the safety limits; only the first part was read.
Imported. A copy of the previous layout was saved as %1$s.
No home screen layout was found in that file.
The file is too large or looks malformed.
The other launcher refused access (it needs a permission this app does not hold).
Import icons, folders and dock from another launcher you have installed or from its backup file. Nothing leaves your phone.
Swipe down on the home screen
Swipe down on an empty spot to open notifications or quick settings. It uses the EXPAND_STATUS_BAR permission and a non-public system call, so it may not work on every phone. Off by default.
Left half opens notifications and right half opens quick settings. Off: the whole screen opens notifications.
Left half opens quick settings and right half opens notifications (or the whole screen opens quick settings if the split is off).
This phone does not let the launcher open that panel. Turn the gesture off in the home settings.
Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern, password or biometrics) in the system settings before hiding apps.
%1$s hidden. You can find it in Settings > Hidden apps, or in the home screen menu.
Apps hidden from the drawer and its search. They open only after you confirm with your fingerprint, face, PIN, pattern or password.
Confirm it is you to see your hidden apps
There is no screen lock, so hidden apps cannot be protected. Set one in the system settings.
No hidden apps. Long-press an app and choose Hide, or use the button above.
Apps you hide disappear from the drawer and search. Icons you already placed on the home screen stay.
Saves your layout, launcher settings and widgets to a file (unencrypted).
Pick a backup file saved earlier and get layout and settings back.
Import from another launcher or place your apps in order.
Backup saved: %1$d home screen items and %2$d settings. The file is not encrypted and lists your installed apps: keep it somewhere you trust.
That file is not an UltimateLauncher backup. To bring another launcher\'s home screen use \"Bring my home screen\".

Widgets: provider, size and position are restored, but NOT their content or internal configuration (each app keeps it and it cannot be copied). After restoring, tap each widget and the system will ask you to accept or configure it again.
Your current home screen will be replaced and the settings in the file applied. An automatic copy is kept inside the app first.
Restored. The previous layout was saved as %1$s.
For closed launchers (OPPO, Huawei, vivo, Honor, Xiaomi, Samsung…) whose screen cannot be read. Puts all your installed apps on pages, in the order you choose.
Folders, dock and the old launcher\'s pages are not imported: they cannot be read without root. Your current dock is kept and the pages are replaced (a copy is saved first).
